description:
List the values Rösti uses for IOC types, IOC tags (with descriptions),
IOC categories and export formats, and explain the false-positive risk
scale. Use these values for the filters of the search and list tools.
name: describe_taxonomy

id.description: Format id, as used by get_export_link

false_positive_risk.default: false_positive_risk rates how likely an IOC is to cause false positives, e.g. a popular domain that also serves benign traffic. level runs from -1 to 5 (higher means more likely to cause false positives) with meanings informational, small, moderate, medium, high and very high. 'no indication' means Rösti has no indication of false-positive risk for the IOC.

title: Describe the taxonomy
